text:
In 2011 international (PPP) dollars, U.S. GDP per capita in 1850 was about $2,825, the Maddison Project Database figure for that year. A separate check—roughly $110 per person in 1850 money, grown at the long-run U.S. rate of about 1.8% a year up to about $50,000 in 2011—lands in the same place, around $2,800–$2,900. Later Maddison revisions and MeasuringWorth’s GDP deflator can shift that point estimate by a few hundred dollars.

CONFIDENCE: 62
